title: Hinamatsuri
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Young yakuza member Yoshifumi Nitta has a psychic girl, Hina, literally fall into his apartment and ends up raising her (to verify). Around them, Hina's fellow psychic Anzu lives with homeless men and learns gratitude, and classmate Hitomi is roped into bartending, in a deadpan comedy about accidental families (to verify).
life_message: It holds up gratitude, honest work and the found families that grow when people take responsibility for each other.
